metadata.description: Room-transition (order-1/2 Markov) occupancy predictor vs PreHeat K=5 Hamming baseline, both driven through a shared RC-network thermal simulator with anticipatory HeatRate heating; compared at matched false-positive rates across 3 synthetic household topologies.
metadata.data_source: synthetic (fallback_plan item 1: no DATASET dependency with room-level adjacency/timestamps available)

examples.input: Topology 'studio_linear_regular' (3 rooms, regularity=0.85): predict room occupancy [15, 30, 45, 60] min ahead and drive anticipatory heating.
Topology 'apartment_star_mixed' (4 rooms, regularity=0.55): predict room occupancy [15, 30, 45, 60] min ahead and drive anticipatory heating.
Topology 'house_5room_irregular' (5 rooms, regularity=0.25): predict room occupancy [15, 30, 45, 60] min ahead and drive anticipatory heating.
